title: Beatrix and the Portrait
author: Juniper Nakamura
blurb: Theo Nakamura, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
